# Wasp

Wasp's recorded description states that it aims at a focused vault with a clean feel, easy-to-read colours and a look that holds together in dark and light. It gives no further detail about which interface elements it restyles, describing itself only as built for notes you come back to rather than notes you file away.

![Wasp screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/santiyounger/Wasp-Obsidian-Theme/HEAD/img/wasp-dark.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Wasp"
    author: "Santi Younger"
    repo:   "santiyounger/Wasp-Obsidian-Theme"
    slug:   "wasp"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/wasp"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/santiyounger/Wasp-Obsidian-Theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/santiyounger/Wasp-Obsidian-Theme/HEAD/img/wasp-dark.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Get into wasp-mode for a focused vault with a clean feel, easy-to-read colors, and a look that holds together in dark and light. Built for notes you come back to, not just notes you file away."
}
```
